Flow.description: ALF-RS-09 FR1/FR3 (LFRDN-339/340 QA gap fix). AF_FL_Reservation_Approved already calls AF_InvoiceSummary_EnsureOnResv when a manager approves a Pending reservation, but that flow only fires on AF_ApprovalStatus__c changing TO "Approved". It never fires for a reservation that auto-confirms straight to "Not Required" (plain 3-Day, or 7-Day with deposit >= threshold) via AF_FL_Reservation_EvaluateApproval's before-save routing - so the majority of reservations, including the main happy-path deal, never got an Invoice Summary, which blocked Sales Order generation downstream. The BRD (ALF-RS-09) ties the initial Invoice record to the reservation deposit itself, not to the approval workflow, so this is the correct trigger point. AF_InvoiceSummaryService.ensureForApprovedReservations is already duplicate-guarded by its own query against AF_InvoiceSummary__c.AF_Opportunity__c, so calling it from both this flow and AF_FL_Reservation_Approved is safe - whichever fires first creates the record, the other is a no-op.
Flow.label: Reservation Auto Confirmed
